sources.title: NLnet open internet / digital commons funding calls
sources.summary: Open-source and digital-commons project funding. Treat call-specific eligibility and programme scope as unresolved until hydrated.
eligibility_text: Call-specific eligibility must be verified before READY.

sources.title: TWNIC Community Grants 2026
sources.summary: Taiwan Internet policy, Internet technology, and digital-equality project grants.
eligibility_text: Applicant must be a domestic or foreign legally registered entity; each organization may submit one proposal.

sources.title: Open Technology Fund Information Controls Research Program 2026
sources.summary: Full-time 3, 6, 9 or 12 month research support for technical research on Internet censorship, surveillance, information controls and related threats.
eligibility_text: Students at any level and junior/mid-career practitioners may apply; a host need not be secured at stage one. Applicants involved in developing, producing, selling or marketing surveillance technology are excluded and require strict review.

sources.title: FAS AI Safety Policy Entrepreneurship Fellowship
sources.summary: Part-time policy entrepreneurship fellowship for concrete frontier-AI policy interventions.
eligibility_text: Requires a genuine frontier-AI policy problem and adoption pathway; approximately five hours per week over five months.

sources.title: MATS Winter 2027 Fellowship
sources.summary: Full-time AI safety research fellowship; acceptance should be treated as a career-scale option rather than side income.
eligibility_text: Authentic AI-safety research fit required; full-time commitment is an acceptance-stage G6 gate.

sources.title: MATS Residency 2027
sources.summary: Six-to-24-month full-time independent AI-safety research residency; evaluate against jobs and salaried PhDs.
eligibility_text: Treat visa, location, IP and outside-work rules as acceptance-stage due diligence.

sources.title: ERA:AI Winter 2027 Fellowship
sources.summary: Ten-week full-time technical AI safety / governance research fellowship in Cambridge.
eligibility_text: Initial written application is low-cost; full-time acceptance competes with other career routes.

sources.title: Astra Fellowship 2027
sources.summary: Empirical AI-safety fellowship with stipend and substantial compute support.
eligibility_text: Requires a genuine AI-safety research thesis; verify duration, location, visa, IP and outside-work terms before acceptance.

sources.title: Tech Policy Press Fellowship Program 2027
sources.summary: Remote part-time 12-month fellowship for public-interest technology policy analysis and reporting.
eligibility_text: Requires prior publicly published work and references; historical applicant volume is very high, so cap marginal application effort.

sources.title: Software Sustainability Institute Fellowship Programme 2027
sources.summary: Research-software fellowship with a flexible activities budget and international research-software network.
eligibility_text: Up to three international Fellows; budget is for fellowship activities rather than unrestricted salary.

sources.title: Anthropic Fellows Program
sources.summary: Current Anthropic Fellow tracks can include research, AI safety/security, ML systems and Economics & Policy.
eligibility_text: No visa sponsorship for the Fellows program; verify an exact live Fellow requisition and existing full-time work authorization before application effort.

sources.title: GitHub Sponsors for open-source contributors
sources.summary: One-time and recurring sponsorship mechanism for eligible open-source contributors in supported regions.
open_markers: eligible to become a sponsored developer
eligibility_text: Contributor must live in a GitHub Sponsors supported region and complete payment/tax onboarding.

sources.title: Open Source Collective fiscal sponsorship
sources.summary: Fiscal-host route allowing qualifying open-source projects to receive and manage grants, donations, and sponsorship without creating their own legal entity.
eligibility_text: Project must satisfy Open Source Collective verification criteria; current host fee is stated on the source page.
